title: chore(ci): modularize workspace build scripts and introduce hermetic test shim
author: Jordan Reyes
release_notes: Refactors CI build and test scripts into modular workspace-aware scripts, adds a hermetic test shim to improve test determinism and reduce flakiness, and bumps several developer tool dependencies. No user-facing behavior changes expected.
description: Context: Our monolithic ci/build.sh and ci/test.sh have become difficult to maintain across multiple packages in the monorepo. This PR splits the scripts into small, composable steps (setup, toolchain-bootstrap, install, build, lint, test, collect-coverage), introduces a hermetic test shim (tools/hermetic-test-shim) that wraps test execution with deterministic environment and cache control, and migrates the GitHub Actions workflows to call the new scripts. Motivation: reduce flakiness, make local debugging faster, and enable per-package cached artifacts for incremental CI runs. Summary of changes (high level): 1) New scripts under scripts/ci/{setup.sh,bootstrap-toolchain.sh,install-packages.sh,build-package.sh,run-lint.sh,run-tests.sh,collect-artifacts.sh}. 2) tools/hermetic-test-shim: a small Go binary (single source file) that sets up isolated TMPDIR, pins environment variables, enforces node/yarn/npm path isolation for JS packages, and coordinates ephemeral sqlite-based test-db seeds for integration tests. 3) .github/workflows/ci.yml: replaced monolithic job steps with calls to the modular scripts and introduced a lightweight caching key strategy that separates npm/go/cache to reduce cross-contamination. 4) package.json and workspace tooling: bumped devDependencies for eslint, jest, and turbo to mitigate known flakiness with older runners. 5) Dockerfile.ci: minor change to install the hermetic shim's binary into the runner image. 6) Makefile: added targets to run pieces of the pipeline locally with the same env used in CI. Checklist: - [x] Split monolithic scripts into modular steps - [x] Add hermetic test shim and unit tests for shim - [x] Update GitHub Actions and runner images - [x] Bump devDependencies with changelog review - [x] Validate against full CI matrix in staging - [x] Add docs/updating-ci.md and usage examples Rationale and notes: - The hermetic shim is intentionally minimal and is implemented as a single-file Go program to avoid additional runtime deps; it is built as part of the ci image. - Caching changes aim to reduce cross-package invalidation while keeping cache keys stable across runner OS updates. We fall back to a conservative key if cache restore fails. - We reduced the matrix dimension for node versions from 3 to 2 for faster CI turnaround while preserving coverage on the oldest supported and latest stable. - This PR does not change runtime code or public API surface. See linked Linear tasks ENG-4215 and ENG-4321 for perf goals and rollout plan. Related: previous work on ci templates and cache-keying (see PRs: #31287, #36890).
commits: Refactor: split ci scripts into modular steps
feat(ci): add hermetic test shim (tools/hermetic-test-shim) and unit tests
chore(ci): update workflows to use new scripts and cache keys
chore(docker): include hermetic shim in CI image
review_comments: Priya Kaur: Requested that hermetic-test-shim log a short trace id for each test run so we can correlate infra flakes — addressed in commit 3 and tests added.
Daniel Ortiz: Asked to surface cache hit/miss metrics as action step outputs; added basic metrics and documented them in docs/updating-ci.md.
Mei Chen: Raised concern about increasing image size; we moved the shim to be built as a tiny static binary and only added ~2.1MB to Dockerfile.ci, measured in staging.
Jordan Reyes: Replied that we will monitor first three weeks for latency regressions and added a Linear follow-up ENG-4380.
Priya Kaur: Approved after minor nits were fixed (script exit code handling, added defensive set -euo pipefail).
ci_log_summary: Initial run: lint failed on an upstream eslint rule (CI run 1). After bumping eslint and applying autofix changes CI rerun passed. A single test flake was reproduced locally and fixed by the hermetic shim seed isolation. All jobs passing on final run.
post_merge_actions: Deployed updated Dockerfile.ci to staging runners on 2026-02-26, added monitoring dashboards for cache hit ratio and test-run variance, and scheduled a follow-up linear task to evaluate rollout impact after two weeks (ENG-4380).
notes_for_release: Non-functional changes to CI/tooling only. Recommend calling out in internal engineering changelog. No external release notes required.
security_implications: Low. The hermetic shim runs as unprivileged user in CI and does not introduce networked services. We added a short audit of the Go code for unsafe syscalls and verified none present.
local_testing_instructions: See docs/updating-ci.md for example Makefile targets. Typical local run: make ci-bootstrap && make ci-install && SCOPE=packages/auth make ci-run-tests. The hermetic shim is invoked automatically by run-tests.sh; pass --shim-disable to opt out for debugging.
